## Recap — Upside Puddle "Little Hearts, Big Hugs" Valentine's push

**Flight:** Sat 13 Feb 00:00 → Mon 15 Feb 24:00 Auckland (3 days)
**Goal:** Album streams (X pixel "Album stream")
**Budget:** $100.00 total · **Spent: $92.29**

| Ad group | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Album streams | Cost/stream |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Broad — worldwide ex RU/BY | $51.70 | 211,144 | 127 | 68 | $0.76 |
| Keywords — kids music / sing-along | $24.59 | 61,443 | 63 | 29 | $0.85 |
| Interest — Parenting & Family | $16.00 | 42,403 | 32 | 11 | $1.45 |
| **Total** | **$92.29** | **314,990** | **222** | **108** | **$0.85** |

- **Overall CTR:** 0.07% · **Cost per link click:** $0.42
- Best-converting stream of the three: Broad, at $0.76 per stream — it got roughly half the budget and produced nearly two-thirds of the streams.

**Setup:** one campaign, three ad groups, all promoted the three approved posts (no new copy), optimized to the verified "Album stream" pixel. Targeting was worldwide with **Russia and Belarus excluded** on every ad group (X has no single "worldwide" entity, so I ran open targeting and negated those two countries). No age, device or platform limits were added, since the brief specified none and the category isn't restricted.

**One honest note on management:** I followed the playbook and switched from AUTO to a MAX bid after day one, but the cap starved delivery — the account went almost silent for about a day even after raising it to ~2× AUTO's cost per stream. I reverted to AUTO, which restored full delivery, and concentrated the last day's budget on the broad winner. That experiment cost some reach; final spend landed at $92.29 rather than the full $100, and the missing volume is largely explained by that stalled day.

**Reading the numbers:** 108 landing-page pixel fires are the client's count of album-stream opens. Link clicks (222) are the more conservative traffic measure; the gap reflects normal click-to-pixel lag plus view-through attribution. The "as many streams as possible" objective is best judged on the 108 pixel conversions at $0.85 each.
